  "reasons": [
    "D combines the stated longer wait for early-ending pupils with the retained earlier departure and schedule-based choice.",
    "A contradicts the retained departure; B adds unsupported promises and equal favouring; C contradicts the passage's statement about journey speed."
  ],
  "syllabus_chapter": "Factual Passage",
  "syllabus_topic": "Inferring the effects and trade-offs of a decision from a factual passage.",
  "syllabus_entitlement": true,
  "presentation_ready": true,
  "question_type_match": true,
  "principle_applicability": "skill_from_stem",
  "decisive_principle_in_excerpts": false,
  "answer_conditions": [
    {
      "condition": "Pupils whose classes ended earlier waited longer after the timetable revision.",
      "status": "explicit",
      "alters_key_if_changed": false,
      "convention_evidence_ids": []
    },
    {
      "condition": "An earlier departure was retained on another route.",
      "status": "explicit",
      "alters_key_if_changed": true,
      "convention_evidence_ids": []
    },
    {
      "condition": "Students were asked to choose the departure suited to their class schedule.",
      "status": "explicit",
      "alters_key_if_changed": false,
      "convention_evidence_ids": []
    }
  ],
  "option_challenges": [
    {
      "option": "A",
      "strongest_reading": "If 'available' means available on their usual route, the alternate route might not help; however, the passage says an earlier departure remained on another route.",
      "correct_under_reading": false,
      "reading_status": "contradicts_stem",
      "convention_evidence_ids": []
    },
    {
      "option": "B",
      "strongest_reading": "A compromise might mean balanced consideration, but the passage does not state a shorter-wait promise for early-ending pupils or equal favouring.",
      "correct_under_reading": false,
      "reading_status": "strained",
      "convention_evidence_ids": []
    },
    {
      "option": "C",
      "strongest_reading": "A later departure might seem more convenient, but the passage expressly says the notice did not describe it as a faster journey.",
      "correct_under_reading": false,
      "reading_status": "contradicts_stem",
      "convention_evidence_ids": []
    }
  ],
  "blocking_defects": [],
  "style_notes": [],
  "cuet_fit": {
    "criteria": {
      "syllabus_objective": {
        "level": 3,
        "evidence": "Tests a central factual-passage skill: drawing a supported inference about a decision's effects."
      },
      "format_authenticity": {

        "evidence": "A valid four-option, single-answer reading-comprehension MCQ; no authenticated comparator was supplied."
      },
      "level_calibration": {
        "level": 3,
        "evidence": "A short passage and one-step inference fit ordinary CUET comprehension demand; no matched comparator was supplied."
      },
      "discrimination_value": {
        "level": 3,
        "evidence": "Distractors turn on identifiable misreadings of route scope, the compromise, and whether a later departure is faster."
      }
    },
    "reasoning_steps": 1,
    "estimated_difficulty": "easy",
    "cognitive_level": "comprehension",
    "exemplar_ids_compared": []
  },
  "option_resolution": [
    {
      "option": "A",
      "status": "contradicted",
      "false_part": "the earlier departure on every route was removed.",
      "premise_source": "passage_scope",
      "evidence_id": "E1.1",
      "premise_quote": "The school retained an earlier departure on another route",
      "reason": "The passage says an earlier departure remained on another route, so it does not support the claim that every route lost one."
    },
    {
      "option": "B",
      "status": "contradicted",
      "false_part": "the notice favoured all finishing times equally.",
      "premise_source": "passage_scope",
      "evidence_id": "E1.1",
      "premise_quote": "The notice described the revision as a compromise between different finishing times.",
      "reason": "The passage describes a compromise, not equal favouring; it neither states nor implies that all finishing times were favoured equally."
    },
    {
      "option": "C",
      "status": "contradicted",
      "false_part": "the notice presented the later departure as quicker.",
      "premise_source": "passage_scope",
      "evidence_id": "E1.1",
      "premise_quote": "It neither promised shorter waits for everyone nor described the later departure as a faster journey.",
      "reason": "The passage expressly says the notice did not describe the later departure as a faster journey."
    },
    {
      "option": "D",
      "status": "supported",
      "false_part": "",
      "premise_source": "excerpt",
      "evidence_id": "E1.1",
      "premise_quote": "Pupils whose classes ended earlier consequently waited longer. The school retained an earlier departure on another route and asked students to choose the departure suited to their class schedule.",
      "reason": "The passage supports both the longer wait and the retained alternative departure for schedule-based choice."
    }
  ]
}
